Game Overview

In Feeding Fish, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the thrilling depths with Feeding Fish. Glide through the ocean, devouring worms to score big while cleverly evading swift, lurking sharks. With intuitive navigation and increasing challenges, sharpen your instincts and survive the underwater chaos for as long as possible in this action-packed arcade adventure.
